human.summary: MAXESS V2 locks the rebuild around one authoritative assessment machine, one state authority, one scoring authority, one validated result contract, and E01-E09 as deterministic Results consumers. Legacy E00 variants are source material, not sacred architecture. The flagship AI Score remains the golden reference, while the same machine is designed to grow into a deterministic knowledge-driven assessment platform for supported AI-and-life topics.
lessons: One authoritative assessment state machine and one validated result contract are the target architecture.
Green means implemented and verified by evidence; code existence alone is never green.
next_best_actions: Execute the MAXESS source-and-architecture inventory, then implement the highest-leverage coherent rebuild work and prove the AI Score golden journey end-to-end.

naya.summary: Execute V2 as the canonical MAXESS architecture/design standard. Inventory before major changes; unify authority; eliminate timing-dependent handoffs, duplicate scoring, DOM scraping, and competing state; preserve proven behavior; verify every gate; maintain green/yellow/red truth; issue human-readable receipt and next execution after each meaningful cycle.
lessons: Every meaningful execution must preserve verification, durable receipt, delivery state, AI-to-AI handoff, learning, and next action.
Do not default to isolated E00/E00.xx patching when coherent architectural work is supported by evidence.
next_best_actions: Perform the complete MAXESS source-and-architecture inventory before the next coherent rebuild implementation.
